rules.rule: In Flutter State classes, ensure 'mounted' is checked after an 'await' before calling setState() or using BuildContext.
Ensure stream subscriptions, animation controllers, audio players, and database/text controllers are properly closed or disposed in dispose().
When executing raw SQL with sqflite, always use parameterized queries with arguments ('whereArgs') instead of string interpolation.
Never commit hardcoded secrets, Firebase service account keys, or sensitive API credentials in source files.
